slice: K2 foundation: direction records, registry and session admission
required: isolated built-wheel install and same unittest gate without root Wenu installed
protected_faults: loss of small JD fraction or implicit time-scale relabelling
unadmitted model/reference/object/resource or wrong ordered batch
cache publication after failed evaluation or reuse against a tighter bound
live session loses its provider or failed opening leaks leases
owned/borrowed lifetime confusion or hidden backend/cleanup failure
SDK import or test collection requires Wenu, graphics or scientific backends

excluded.legacy scientific and graphical suites: No existing src/wenu code, catalogue, resource, backend or runtime dependency changes; no current consumer imports the new SDK.
excluded.unrelated providers: No real provider is part of this slice; neither SDK nor test fixtures import one.
excluded.release integration: No product routing or installed combination changes; isolated-wheel evidence is required before this foundation can be accepted. Final integration remains required for K3 production adapters.

collection_change: Root pytest testpaths is explicitly tests; new independent projects are not silently added to the legacy full-suite command.

verification.source_digest_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted repository path + NUL + exact file bytes + NUL for every Python file in the named directory
verification.fault_injection: removing row-order validation makes shared provider gate fail; original restored and 32 tests pass
